title: About
description: Devotion Creative provides web design and optional website management for local service businesses. Based in Gallatin, Tennessee, and run by John Choi.
heading: Web design for local service businesses.
introduction: Devotion Creative is a web design and website management business based in Gallatin, Tennessee.
description_text: We help local service businesses explain what they do, build trust, and make it easier for visitors to get in touch. Each project starts with a clear understanding of the business and the customers it serves.
background: John Choi is the founder of Devotion Creative. His background in product design and strategy shapes websites that help customers find what they need and get in touch.
He also serves as Senior UX Designer and Product Owner at The Nature Conservancy, where he works on nature.org and other digital products.
Outside of work, John enjoys training Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, reading science fiction, and spending time with his family.
approach_text: You work directly with John from the first screenshot review through design and launch. Before website work begins, we agree on a written proposal covering the scope, price, and estimated build timeline.
support_text: Ongoing website management is optional. If you choose it, support starts at launch and includes hosting, platform-appropriate maintenance, monthly checks, and a defined allowance for content updates.
review_heading: Start with a useful second look.
review_text: Your Free Marked-Up Website Review is a screenshot with practical suggestions, usually emailed within one business day of your request. The suggestions are yours to use, with no sales call required.
